h1: The Cool Way to Lose Fat

blocks.html: CoolSculpting®, also known as cryolipolysis, reduces unwanted body fat through gentle, controlled cooling of targeted cells. Patients experience a brief few minutes of intense cold, following temporary numbness, and can resume normal activities without any downtime. CoolSculpting® works by subjecting the targeted fat cells to extreme cold which causes the subcutaneous fat cells to die off naturally. These cells are eliminated from the body naturally without damaging the outer layer of skin. Many people prefer this procedure because despite trying exercise and dieting, it can be difficult to remove unwanted stubborn fat without some additional help.
Many patients choose to have the CoolSculpting® treatment delivered to:

items: Reduce excess fat on the abdomen, flanks, and love handles
Shape inner and outer thighs to their liking

blocks.text: What Are the Costs of CoolSculpting®?

blocks.html: Like any procedure that is performed to enhance one’s aesthetic appeal, CoolSculpting® is a highly personal one. Treatment costs will vary depending on the areas you elect to have CoolSculpting® performed on as well as the amount of fat that is needing to be reduced. CoolSculpting® can provide permanent reduction of fat cells up to 20-25%. In order to determine the proper pricing for your needs, it is best to Schedule a FREE consultation at our Austin office so we can help you decide if CoolSculpting® is right for you.
